messages:
ci-bot: CI on main just failed after merge — job: pipeline/full-tests (build 1743105599) -> https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/1743105599
ci-bot: Failing test: tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_cache_eviction (timeout/AssertionError)
mike: who merged last? pinging @josh since his PR landed 3m ago :eyes:
leah: I'm on it. grabbing logs and will try a local reproduce. @sam can we pause merges briefly?
sam: paused the merge queue — adding hold tag :white_check_mark:
dana: I can queue a manual rerun on a larger runner while leah looks: `/ci retry 1743105599 --runner=large`
ci-bot: manual rerun requested by dana — new build 1743105615 started
leah: quick glance at logs: looks like kv eviction path hit a race, but unsure if it's flaky or regression. stack snippet:```
AssertionError: expected key to be present
  File "redwood/serving/kv_cache.py", line 243, in evict_if_needed
```
josh: I didn't change kv_cache in my PR, but my change touched batching logic. I'll run the test locally now.
mike: logs also show a bunch of small OOM-ish allocations on the runner just before the failure — maybe runner size matters
dana: rerun finished — still red (build 1743105615). same test failing, same stack
leah: ok, leaning toward regression introduced between HEAD~4 and HEAD. I'll start a quick git bisect. running: `git bisect start main origin/main~0 HEAD` then `git bisect run pytest tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_cache_eviction -q`
sam: if bisect finds a culprit, let's request the author to quickly revert or patch. @josh fyi
josh: happy to help with bisect or try a small repro harness. starting a local bisect run now
ci-bot: FYI — pipeline incident checklist created: https://incident.internal/redwood/INC-1743 (auto)
mike: created a short-lived branch with a revert candidate for the batching change: `revert/batching-try` if bisect points there
leah: bisect progress: tested 5 commits, suspecting commit e7a9d3a (author: sam), but still running full bisect to confirm
dana: heads-up to mobile infra team — they rely on main CI status for canary deploys, holding deploys until green
josh: local bisect reproduced the failure; I can narrow to the batching change. pushing a draft PR with a tentative fix in ~30m
leah: thanks. once josh posts PR, let's run full CI on that branch with the larger runner. if green, we'll merge fix + revert candidate as needed
mike: thx everyone. keeping merge queue paused until green. will update the incident doc with links
sam: updating channel when status changes :thumbsup:
